description: One competition with its fields, the stage of each, its timeline from the announcement to the reserve list, and the text of its notice. Test dates are not on this site: EPSO gives them to each candidate. When you present an offer, link to "url", its page on the site, and to "official_url", the official notice.

reference.description: The reference as the institution prints it, such as "EPSO/AD/427/26", or the address of the page on this site (the field "url" of a list).
